checkpoints.summary: Wave 32 release-lane diagnosis of PR #14 (`codex/qa004-staging-campaign`). Read-only triage only; no workflow, branch-protection, deployment, credential, or product change was made. (iv) The `CodeQL` failure is NOT a workflow job: check-run 106862973938 is a GitHub Advanced Security code-scanning gate (app slug `github-advanced-security`, app id 57789, check suite 96831076767, no workflow run behind it), which is why `gh run view --job 106862973938` returns 404. It carries 96 open, undismissed, unfixed alerts including 1 critical (alert #16, `js/request-forgery`, `app/api/discover/route.ts:351`). The repository's own `CodeQL (JavaScript/TypeScript)` job in security-scans.yml uses the same `security-extended` suite and PASSED - that job asserts the analysis uploaded, the platform check asserts no new alerts. Nothing was dismissed; routed to `integrations` as HF-RELEASE-SEC-CODEQL. (ii) The `Lint And Build` failure is a genuine tsc result, not pipeline instability: step 11 `Typecheck` ran 17:38:34Z->18:46:52Z (68m18s) of a 70m40s job and emitted 1,384 primary diagnostics across 407 files. The invocation (`NODE_OPTIONS='--max-old-space-size=8192' tsc --noEmit` on a 4-core/16GB ubuntu-latest runner) and memory setting are correct; the log contains zero heap-out-of-memory/FATAL ERROR/ENOMEM/Killed/SIGKILL matches, and no job `timeout-minutes` is set, so the 360-minute default applied and nothing timed out. The 1h10m40s is real single-pass tsc work, matching the known slow-typecheck profile already recorded in RELEASE-006; no timeout or memory change was made because any value chosen from a FAILING run's timings would be a guess. The root cause is upstream schema/type drift owned by `database` (TS2345 on `venue_crew_members`, `venue_team_contractors`, `get_staff_dashboard_stats`, which exist in no migration and no generated type) - handed off as HF-RELEASE-DB-TYPECHECK. The gate is correctly failing and must not be bypassed: no `continue-on-error`, no `if: always()` on the downstream steps, and no tsconfig relaxation were added. Branch protection on `main` is now CONFIGURED (200, not the stale 404 recorded in this task): strict required checks over 10 contexts, 1 approving review, stale-review dismissal, last-push approval, admin enforcement, linear history, no force pushes, no deletions, conversation resolution; `required_signatures` is false. Exactly three required checks block this PR: `Database Types` FAILURE, `Lint And Build` FAILURE, `E2E Tests (Playwright)` CANCELLED. The `Vercel` and Advanced Security `CodeQL` failures do NOT block the merge because neither is a required check. Remaining enforcement gaps against acceptance criterion 3 (production build, migration checks, and the service-role audit exist only as post-Typecheck steps inside `Lint And Build`; the Advanced Security CodeQL gate, `Dependency review`, and `Migrations And RLS Matrix` run but are not required) are reported read-only as HF-RELEASE-005-REQUIRED-CHECKS; no protection setting was modified.
